long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The telescope is mine to sit beside until dusk, and I am not explaining that to anyone.
I will keep a picture of the telescope, since I claimed it first.
Those seeds from the Italian attic have been on my mind more than is reasonable, so I will read about them.
The high perch lets me see everything arriving on the island, and I prefer to see it first.
I will sit where I can see the telescope and wait for the light to change.

today.reason: The bowl is empty until morning, and the eat step was turned down, so I will keep to the telescope, the bookshelf and the high perch instead.
